question: Can Intel deliver the durable census and external baseline substrate that unblocks cross-site transfer: (1) acquire WebArena-Verified v2 812-task census via durable pinned source (HuggingFace OpenEnv BrowserGym hosted layer or Docker am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping@sha256:3e8cb9b945ea9b1c94ab26dba53e8d12dd0406abbf4bf686fd3bb2b6a5908feb with 64-char hash byte-identical manifest, SHA d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30 verified, HF_TOKEN for WebGym 292k 292k tasks/127k sites manifest sample >=50 diverse eTLD+1 for duplication CI (2000 family-level bootstrap) and threshold sweep 0.818-0.9479 to replace exhaustive 567MB LFS test.zip) and prove >=10 product families constructible (deterministic random.Random(35725763380).sample(sorted families_ge3,10)x2 with get_task_start_url __SHOPPING__ expansion + product-subtree anchoring heading/price/add-to-cart/main/contentinfo node_count>1 distinct SHA on path families 136/145/196/222 at 1280x720 CDP AX>10), and (2) blindly reproduce external SOTA baselines (Agentic Compilation DSM 99% TreeWalker+deterministic JSON IR+HITL $0.002-0.092 80-94% compile, TraceCompiler def-use 0.928/0.943, browser-memory catalog) on SPIDER synthetic 40-task alias-OOD (30 orthogonal header/body/auth+10 mixed) with trajectory-grouped bootstrap coverage/CIs and honest per-trajectory-reset sum-counter M_total_f10 Pareto f=10/100 vs SPIDER alias-catalog/routing/WebMCP, measuring where SPIDER must beat O(1) compilation to claim residual-novelty economics and whether hybrid WebMCP bypass 0.725 prevalence dominates?
hypothesis: H_A_DURABLE_CENSUS_EXPANDED: A byte-identical durable pin verified as manifest SHA d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30 (927596 bytes pinned) with Docker digest sha256:3e8cb9b945ea9b1c94ab26dba53e8d12dd0406abbf4bf686fd3bb2b6a5908feb (64 hex) via >=2 genuine attempts per source (HF_TOKEN bearer capture, Hub API 200, docker pull --digests / docker load fallback, 300s timeout) yields a verifiable WebArena-Verified v2 census (total 812 +-10, shopping 192, families_ge3 >=30) and, with deterministic random.Random(35725763380).sample(sorted families_ge3,10) executed TWICE with get_task_start_url __SHOPPING__ expansion and product-subtree anchoring (heading/price/add-to-cart/main/contentinfo node_count>1, distinct SHA before==after identical TRUE and after mutation != TRUE on canonical path families 136/145/196/222 at 1280x720 CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree median AX>10 median DOM>=2000), proves >=10 distinct product families constructible with anchoring and SHA stability (16/16 both directions on probed families plus WebGym 292k diverse sample >=50 distinct eTLD+1 with family-level B=2000 bootstrap duplication prevalence CI and threshold sweep 0.818-0.9479 range >=0.05 replacing exhaustive 567MB LFS test.zip). H_B_SOTA_CEILING_HONEST_PARETO: On SPIDER deterministic synthetic 40-task alias-OOD (research/intel/synthetic_alias_ood_40.json seed 360360, 10 header-param +10 body-param +10 auth-param +10 mixed multi-channel orthogonal channels, generator sha logged) blind reproduction per published recipe of B-AGENTIC-DSM (DSM 99% TreeWalker + deterministic JSON IR + HITL patch $0.002-0.092 80-94% compile), B-TRACECOMPILER-DEFUSE (def-use 0.928/0.943), B-BMEM-CATALOG (deterministic replay) alongside identically-measured SPIDER baselines B-SPIDER-ALIAS, B-SPIDER-ROUTING, B-SPIDER-WEBMCP and B-COLD-LLM yields trajectory-grouped B=2000 95% CIs for coverage and for honest per-trajectory-reset sum-counter M_total_f10 and M_total_f100 (resolve+bind+verify+freshness+browser_steps, amortized f=10/100, per-task logs, no n*3200/jitter) with |rho_shuffled|<0.20, revealing the O(1) compilation ceiling that SPIDER must beat for C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY (rho>=0.60 cost tracks residual novelty not length noise) and whether hybrid WebMCP tool-bypass prevalence 0.725 amortized f10/f100 dominates browsing-only Pareto.
falsifier: H_A falsified if after >=2 genuine attempts per durable source (HF and Docker, each timeout>=300s, docker load/ghcr mirror fallback, HF_TOKEN true/false logged, Hub digest 200 verification) no byte-identical manifest with SHA d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30 and 64-char digest sha256:3e8cb9b945ea9b1c94ab26dba53e8d12dd0406abbf4bf686fd3bb2b6a5908feb is produced with pinned census artifact, OR WebGym 292k diverse sample <50 distinct eTLD+1 or family-level bootstrap B=2000 duplication CI not computed or threshold sweep 0.818-0.9479 range<0.05 (lacking replacement for exhaustive 567MB LFS test.zip), OR deterministic random.Random(35725763380).sample(sorted families_ge3,10)x2 with get_task_start_url __SHOPPING__ expansion + product-subtree anchoring (heading/price/add-to-cart/main/contentinfo node_count>1 distinct SHA) fails to demonstrate >=10 product families with SHA stability both directions and CDP 1280x720 AX median>10 on canonical families 136/145/196/222 (bounded falsified to 4 families per prior audit remains). H_B falsified if external baselines cannot be executed blind on the 40 alias-OOD with per-task logs producing interior non-degenerate trajectory-grouped CIs for coverage and honest M_total_f10/f100 (width>0, variance>0), OR they are indistinguishable from null controls (coverage within null permutation 95% CI, |rho_shuffled|>=0.20, HITL drop<0.30, delta_vs_truncated<0.20), OR WebMCP prevalence not measurable. Single-module falsification yields overall MIXED; both fail yields FALSIFIED. Measurement failure (<2 genuine attempts, missing 64-char digest/sha/provenance, non-grouped or jitter proxies, fallback AX snapshot, missing body regex) triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID not falsification.

positive_control.description: Three positive controls: (PC-A) Synthetic Flask product fixture at 1280x720 with fixed DOM (heading+price+add-to-cart+main+contentinfo) served localhost, known AX tree ~17 nodes, outerHTML deterministic. Pipeline must capture median AX>10, DOM>=2000, SHA before==after identical TRUE, must detect visible textContent mutation as SHA != (repeat x3). (PC-B) Toy single-header param task where Agentic DSM minimal example compiles deterministically to JSON IR and achieves coverage 1.0 blind. (PC-C) WebGym diverse-sanity: on WebGym 292k manifest, sampling >=50 diverse eTLD+1 with family-level grouping yields duplication prevalence within [0.3,0.99] and sweep monotonic (threshold 0.818 prevalence <= threshold 0.9479) demonstrating pipeline not vacuous.
positive_control.expected: PC-A VALID captures >=2 with stability both directions TRUE; PC-B coverage 1.0 on toy; PC-C sweep monotonic and CI computable; otherwise harness invalid MEASUREMENT_INVALID

null_control.description: Three nulls trajectory-grouped: (NC1) Family-label shuffle for duplication/coverage: permutation of task family labels (trajectory-grouped, 1000 perms for coverage, 2000 family-level for WebGym duplication) applied to duplication prevalence and to baseline coverage; expected |rho_shuffled|<0.20, coverage shuffle mean ~ chance, gap real-shuffle >=0.20 vs real. (NC2) Truncated baseline B-TRUNCATED-20 vs full-tree: delta_vs_truncated >=0.20 must hold to show full-tree not vacuous; shuffled version must not. (NC3) HITL patch disabled / random patch null: Agentic DSM with HITL hook replaced by no-op or random string patch must drop coverage >=0.30 vs HITL, isolating HITL contribution. All nulls trajectory-grouped family-level, not transition-grouped.
null_control.expected: NC1 |rho|<0.20 p>0.05 for shuffled, NC2 delta<0.05 for shuffled truncated, NC3 coverage delta >=0.30 for HITL

measurement_validity: MV1_DURABLE_ATTEMPTS: Each durable source (HF for WebArena 812 + WebGym 292k, Docker for WebArena) requires >=2 genuine attempts logged with canonical path+hash: attempt URL, HTTP status/returncode, bytes, sha256 hex, 64-char digest substring check (len 64 hex), timeout >=300s or docker load fallback path captured (docker pull ... or docker load < tar), stderr/stdout captured. Single-attempt success is MEASUREMENT_INVALID. HF_TOKEN present true/false logged. Evidence paths: artifacts/raw/webarena_verified_pin.json, artifacts/raw/hf_manifest_attempts.json, artifacts/raw/docker_hub_api_attempts.json, provenance.json hashes.

MV2_BYTE_IDENTITY: WebArena manifest byte-identicalness via SHA d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30 hex digest equality stored (927596 bytes); Docker digest_form exactly sha256:3e8cb9b945ea9b1c94ab26dba53e8d12dd0406abbf4bf686fd3bb2b6a5908feb (64 hex after colon) with Hub API verification 200. If only one source succeeds, single sha256 pinned file + download log suffices but cross-source equality must be explicitly marked unavailable, not assumed equal. WebGym 292k manifest SHA separately logged when HF_TOKEN succeeds. Docker digest and manifest SHA byte-identicalness hashes stored in freeze.json and provenance.json.

MV3_AX_REPAIR: Fragment repair requires BrowserGym-core==0.14.3, AgentLab==0.4.2, Playwright==1.63.0, playwright install --with-deps chromium verified via pip freeze sha256 nonempty and playwright --version + browser validation. Viewport strictly 1280x720. CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree must be used (client.send via cdp_session) — fallback accessibility.snapshot counts as degraded and triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID for H_A. Metrics median AX>10, median DOM>=2000, outerHTML body regex + 9 base + expanded stripping (form_key/uenc/store/session/timestamp/nonce/fotorama\d{6,}) applied BEFORE SHA256 via page.evaluate, recomputed AFTER page.content()+AX, grammar hash live recomputed via research/intel/grammar_fulltree_*.py with body regex <body[^>]*>.*?</body> DOTALL present, not hardcoded. Provenance: ax_captures.jsonl, derived/ax_consistency_fulltree.json, grammar sha256 live.

MV4_PRODUCT_FAMILY_CONSTRUCTIBILITY: Deterministic constructibility test must be executed as specified: sorted families_ge3 from webarena_census.json, two independent draws Random(35725763380).sample(sorted_families_ge3,10) (python random.Random seeded exactly 35725763380), each family probed via get_task_start_url expansion of __SHOPPING__ placeholder plus product-subtree anchoring requiring heading/price/add-to-cart/main/contentinfo present with node_count>1 and distinct SHA (outerHTML SHA256 with MV3 stripping) on path families 136/145/196/222 canonical verification at 1280x720 CDP. For each sampled family, at least one product_page_tasks probe must show distinct SHA and anchoring true to count as constructible. Overall constructible count = distinct families with anchoring true among both samples plus census product_page_families baseline. Without BOTH deterministic samples executed and logged (sample lists, per-family anchoring json), H_A inconclusive -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID for that clause. Ten-family threshold is product hold-out gate.

MV5_WEBGYM_DIVERSE_AND_THRESHOLD_SWEEP: WebGym 292k manifest (127k sites) when HF_TOKEN succeeds must be sampled to >=50 distinct eTLD+1 with documented eTLD+1 extraction, family-level grouping preserved, duplication prevalence computed as proportion with Jaccard/template duplication above threshold (threshold defined, e.g., normalized template Jaccard >=0.90), family-level bootstrap B=2000 (resampling unit=family, not task) for 95% percentile CI, and threshold sweep at 0.818 and 0.9479 endpoints documented with range = prevalence_0.9479 - prevalence_0.818 >=0.05 required to replace exhaustive 567MB LFS test.zip (sweep monotonic). If HF_TOKEN absent / 401, diverse count null must be explicitly recorded as unavailable with 2 genuine HF_WEBGYM attempts logged (>=300s), not assumed zero; then this MV clause alone does not trigger MEASUREMENT_INVALID but H_A partially unavailable (bounded). When HF succeeds, missing B=2000 CI or sweep is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

MV6_SYNTHETIC_ALIAS_OOD: Synthetic 40 tasks generation seed deterministic (360360), generation code hash logged, split 30 orthogonal (10 header-only/10 body-only/10 auth-only) +10 mixed (header+body+auth) preserved in artifact research/intel/synthetic_alias_ood_40.json sha 6f42bc82cb..., per-task channel label orthogonality verified (no cross-channel leakage). If file missing, generate deterministically and hash generation script. Mixed tasks must combine all three channels with independent alias rotations.

MV7_HONEST_COST: All cost metrics M_total_f10 and M_total_f100 are per-trajectory-reset sum-counters (resolve + bind + verify + freshness_check + browser_steps) reset per trajectory/task, summed, then amortized at f=10 and f=100 (sum / min(f,N) verified). Prohibited proxies n*3200, f*6.0, Gaussian jitter, n*constant are MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Trajectory-grouped bootstrap B=2000 resampling unit=task/trajectory (not transition), 95% CI [lower,upper] non-degenerate width reported when variance>0; degenerate [0,0] or [1,1] variance 0 flagged per prereg 12.7 and NOT counted as valid width but not invalid gate. Negative shuffle controls use |rho_shuffled|<0.20 threshold on cost vs length correlation, trajectory-grouped.

MV8_EXTERNAL_BLINDNESS: External baselines implemented blind per recipe citations without tuning to synthetic OOD split labels; code paths logged, recipe doc references (DSM TreeWalker IR schema, TraceCompiler def-use rule, catalog replay selector) stored. Per-task logs for all 40 tasks per baseline required (artifacts/derived/sota_blind_results.jsonl 240 rows + per-channel breakdown). Fixture-agnostic: same 40-task split for all baselines in one run. Harness sha256 logged and re-run byte-identity verified.

MV9_PROVENANCE: Every artifact path+sha256 stored in provenance.json: request/spec/prereg/freeze hashes, pip freeze hash nonempty, docker images --digests hash, command logs for pull/load/run, HF manifest sha256/bytes (or 401 log), WebGym manifest sha when available, generation script hash, per-baseline result jsonl (327 rows including toy), census derived json, ax captures/probe logs, threshold sweep table. Missing provenance for any durability or cost path -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID for that module.
decision_rule: Frozen three-way rule evaluated after MEASUREMENT_INVALID check: (A) MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any MV1-MV4/MV6-MV9 mandatory gating fails: <2 genuine attempts per required durable source, missing 64-char digest or manifest sha d6527566..., pip freeze empty or version/viewport mismatch, fallback AX snapshot used, body regex absent, deterministic sampling not executed exactly as specified, honest-cost proxy/ungrouped CI detected, or provenance missing — then no SURVIVES/FALSIFIED inference, status MEASUREMENT_INVALID. MV5 WebGym diversity clause alone defaults to UNAVAILABLE not INVALID when HF_TOKEN absent after 2 genuine attempts (marked null with attempts logged). (B) SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST iff A passes (with MV5 either PASS or documented UNAVAILABLE) AND module H_A_SURVIVES: (SRC_HF_SUCCESS OR SRC_DOCKER_SUCCESS) with census artifact manifest_sha256=d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30 total_tasks 700-812 families_ge3 >=30 AND deterministic family constructibility >=10 distinct product families with product-subtree anchoring true and SHA stability both directions TRUE and CDP 1280x720 median AX>10 & median DOM>=2000 proven on canonical path families 136/145/196/222 plus WebGym diverse >=50 eTLD+1 with family-level B=2000 duplication CI non-degenerate and threshold sweep 0.818-0.9479 range>=0.05 when HF succeeds (or explicitly unavailable) AND module H_B_SURVIVES: all three external baselines B-AGENTIC-DSM/B-TRACECOMPILER-DEFUSE/B-BMEM-CATALOG executed blind on 40 alias-OOD with per-task logs, coverage point estimates + trajectory-grouped 95% CIs interior non-degenerate for DSM/ALIAS (degenerate BMEM/ROUTING/WEBMCP [0,0]/[1,1] flagged not counted), honest M_total_f10 and M_total_f100 with CIs, |rho_shuffled|<0.20, SPIDER baselines measured identically for Pareto comparison, WebMCP prevalence 0.725 CI measured, and positive controls PC-A/PC-B passed (PC-C pass when HF succeeds). (C) FALSIFIED_IN_SETTING if A passes but B thresholds fail after genuine attempts: e.g., durable sources persistent 401/404 or byte mismatch after 2 attempts, or deterministic sampling still yields only 4 product families (136/145/196/222) not >=10 (bounded FALSIFIED for 10-family gate), or AX median <=10/SHA stability false, or WebGym diverse <50 or sweep range<0.05 when HF succeeds, or external baselines fail to run blind or are indistinguishable from NC1/NC2/NC3 shuffles (coverage within null CI or |rho|>=0.20 or HITL null not worse by >=0.30 or delta_vs_truncated<0.20). Outcome MIXED if one module survives and the other falsified. All thresholds frozen; single-family degenerate full-page LCP 0.0 variance explicitly NOT counted as valid AX signal; degenerate CIs [0,0]/[1,1] variance0 explicitly NOT counted as valid width per prereg 12.7.
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES: Intel delivers CODEC-accepted durable census artifacts (pinned manifest SHA d6527566... + Docker digest 3e8cb9b9... + WebGym 292k diverse-sample duplication CI and threshold sweep 0.818-0.9479 replacing 567MB LFS) unblocking Graph's >=10-family product hold-out design—next Graph experiment can use deterministic Random(35725763380).sample hold-out without re-probing liveness; repaired BrowserGym fragment pipeline (1280x720 CDP AX>10 + body+expanded stripping + anchored geometry) becomes shared substrate for runtime/graph; external baseline reproduction defines O(1) compilation ceiling (DSM $0.002-0.092 M_total_f10 22.6/F100 5.65 USD $0.035/task, ALIAS 30.1/7.53) that SPIDER must beat for residual-novelty economics; hybrid WebMCP bypass 0.725 prevalence establishes tool-bypass vs browsing dispatch Pareto—Product can run honest Stagehand/WebMCP vs compilation Pareto to decide VALIDATED vs hybrid learned dispatch promotion. C-CROSSSITE advances toward EXPERIMENTAL at durable-artifact+diverse-holdout ceiling, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY/C-PRODUCT-ECON gain honest Pareto baseline.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED: Deterministically proven that pinned 812-task census contains only 4 constructible product families (136/145/196/222) with product-subtree anchoring, so Graph >=10-family product hold-out remains BLOCKED on this census—requires alternative census (WebMall/Mind2Web-2 130-task BrowserGym loopback, expanded shopping_admin 184-task/42-family superset, or Mind2Web definition) or definition expansion (shopping vs shopping_admin 404), and must not re-attempt N=20 longest-prefix on same 4-family substrate (expected MEASUREMENT_INVALID). If WebGym diverse <50 or sweep fails, duplication 0.9479 single-store not replaced—holdout without site diversity remains vacuous. If external baselines falsify (cannot reproduce blind or perform at null level), published O(1) ceilings not transferable to SPIDER alias-OOD or synthetic orthogonal design misaligned—requires redesign of alias-OOD channels or HITL cost model before Product claims residual-novelty economics; SPIDER alias-catalog flat p=0.626 vs DSM structured collapse indicates site-stability rather than alias robustness. C-CROSSSITE stays HYPOTHESIS/EXPERIMENTAL at 4-family ceiling, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY/C-PRODUCT-ECON remain HYPOTHESIS. If MEASUREMENT_INVALID, no claim update; smallest repair is infra fix per MV1-MV9 (genuine attempts >=2, versions, CDP path, deterministic sample, honest counters, trajectory-grouped family-level bootstrap, threshold sweep) and re-run identical frozen design.
estimated_cost: Compute: runner 3-5h wall (docker pull 5.4GB if not cached, 2x genuine attempts HF+Docker each 300s or docker load fallback ~15-30min, WebGym manifest fetch with HF_TOKEN 292k manifest parse/sample ~15min, deterministic family sampling + get_task_start_url __SHOPPING__ expansion + anchored AX probe on >=10 families (13 WebArena pages + 3 synthetic + WebGym-driven expanded probes) ~20-30min, synthetic 40-task x 7 baselines =280 task executions + trajectory-grouped B=2000 bootstrap + threshold sweep ~60-90min). Network: HF manifests 2x attempts + Hub API digest check + WebGym 292k download only if HF_TOKEN valid. Tokens: no LLM calls required (synthetic + deterministic harness; optional LLM excluded). USD ~$3-5 GH runner + $0 if HF_TOKEN cached. Artifact storage <80MB. Deterministic sampling ensures no extra browser cost if Docker unreachable (synthetic fixture fallback).
expected_information_gain: High (Director-ranked gating). Directly answers whether 22-deep Intel tunnel can escape 4-family ceiling via specified deterministic anchoring protocol and whether 567MB LFS exhaustive enumeration is replaceable by threshold sweep 0.818-0.9479 with family-level bootstrap—unblocking Physics Gate0 (|S|>=16 titles>=1) and Frontier heterogeneous shootout and Graph >=10-family parameterized hold-out. Quantifies O(1) compilation comparator (DSM F10 22.6 USD $0.035/task vs ALIAS F10 30.1) and hybrid WebMCP 0.725 prevalence dominance—deciding if SPIDER alias-catalog/routing beats $0.002-0.092 amortized compilation for residual-novelty rho>=0.60 economics or must pivot to tool-bypass hybrid dispatch. A bounded negative (still 4 families, WebGym 401, or DSM structured collapse) is equally decision-changing: it hard-documents census ceiling and dispatch requirement, preventing another 8th repeat of same AX substrate and informing Scout global direction. Comparatively higher leverage than another N=20 AX_consistency or exhaustive LFS enumeration.
